Services

What we do for you

Everything a family practice does, from the first cough to the long-term care of diabetes or heart disease. Pick a service to request it.

Flu jabs are here

From 6 October: just come to the open consultation, Mon - Fri 8:00 - 9:30. Recommended from 60, in pregnancy and with a long-term illness. Bring your vaccination card.

Check-ups

The health check from 35 every three years, once between 18 and 34, skin cancer screening from 35, blood tests and ECG.

Request a check-up

Vaccinations

All vaccinations the Standing Committee on Vaccination (STIKO) recommends - tetanus, flu, COVID-19, shingles, pneumococcus. We check your card.

Request a vaccination

Sick notes

Come to the open consultation. Known patients with a mild illness can get a sick note for up to five days by phone.

See the open consultation

Travel medicine

Advice and vaccinations for your trip - come six weeks before you leave. Often self-pay; many insurers pay it back.

Request travel advice

Home visits

For patients who cannot come to us. Ask by 11:00 and a doctor comes the same afternoon; nursing homes every Wednesday.

Request a home visit

Long-term care

Care programmes for diabetes, asthma, COPD and coronary heart disease, with a check every quarter and your results explained.

Request a follow-up

Without an appointment

For new complaints, sick notes and flu jabs.

Mon - Fri 8:00 - 9:30
  • Arrive by 9:30. Waiting times are longest on Monday.
  • Bring your health insurance card.
  • With a fever, ring the bell at the side door - we see you in a separate room.

When we are closed

Nights, weekends and holidays.

  • 112Emergencies: chest pain, trouble breathing, signs of a stroke, heavy bleeding.
  • 116 117The medical on-call service, when it cannot wait until we open.
  • Pharmacies on duty are listed in every pharmacy window.
Appointment request

Ask for an appointment

Tell us what it is about and when you can come. We call you back within one working day with a time.

1. What is it about?

For something new and urgent, come to the open consultation Mon - Fri 8:00 - 9:30 - no appointment needed.

Ask by 11:00 for a visit the same afternoon. Please give your address below.

2. Your insurance

You receive an invoice under the German scale of medical fees (GOÄ); we tell you the price before.

3. When suits you?
4. Your details

Welcome! Please see what to bring to your first visit.

Not for emergencies

In an emergency call 112. When we are closed and it cannot wait, the medical on-call service answers on 116 117.

We call you back within one working day. Requests reach the practice encrypted and go into your record only.

Repeat prescription

For medicines you already take regularly. Ready from 14:00 on the next working day.

Name, strength and pack size, one per line - as on the pack.

How do you want it?

New patients: what to bring

  1. Your health insurance cardor your private insurance's details.
  2. Your medication planor the packs of everything you take, also from the pharmacy without a prescription.
  3. Your vaccination cardthe yellow booklet - we check what is due.
  4. Letters and resultsfrom hospitals and other doctors, if you have them.
  5. Fifteen minutesto fill in the registration form at reception before your first appointment.

Step-free access

  • A ramp from the courtyard to the door, everything on one floor.
  • Doors 90 cm wide, an accessible toilet and a wheelchair to borrow.
  • Two disabled parking spaces in the courtyard, entrance from Kastanienallee.
  • A hearing loop at reception; we call you by name and by number.
  • Guide and assistance dogs are welcome.
  • By busLines 4 and 7 to Kastanienallee, every 15 minutes from the station.
  • By carCar park Am Markt, three minutes on foot - reception gives you a ticket for the first hour.

Professional titles

Specialist in general medicine (Fachärztin für Allgemeinmedizin) and specialist in internal medicine (Facharzt für Innere Medizin), both awarded in Germany.

Chamber and supervision

Ärztekammer Niedersachsen; for statutory insurance the Kassenärztliche Vereinigung Niedersachsen. The professional code of the Ärztekammer Niedersachsen applies.

Privacy

This site sets no cookies and loads no trackers.

Requests and prescriptions

What you send through the two forms reaches the practice encrypted and is kept in your patient record, like everything you tell us in person. We do not answer medical questions by email.

Confidentiality

Everyone in the practice is bound by medical confidentiality. You may ask to see your record, have it corrected or receive a copy - ask Amara Mensah at reception.
